findings.title: direct-call shortcut drops the user's input for tools whose parameters are all optional
findings.detail: capability.comes.executor.can_direct_call treats 'no required parameters' as 'call with no arguments'. astrbot_plugin_teamup's 组队昵称 declares nickname: str = "", so Core's schema (faithfully) has no required field; Stella skips the model and calls it with {}, the plugin answers with its usage text, and Comes still reports status success. 3/3 attempts.
findings.suggested_fix: only direct-call when the schema has no properties at all, or when known slots cover the optional ones
findings.status: fixed in Stella PR #132 (not merged yet)

findings.title: MCP session DELETE answered with 202
findings.detail: Core's rmcp Streamable HTTP service answers DELETE /mcp with 202; the Python MCP SDK in Stella's env only treats 200/204 as success and logs 'Session termination failed: 202'. Harmless.
